core5Default.appliesTo: all CORE5 covered decisions unless an explicit resolution below refines an OPEN/pending path

explicitResolutions.future15.hiyori.bodyAdornment: Small simple lobe stud(s) are Current baseline; personal and low-density. No additional piercing or tattoo may be inferred.

explicitResolutions.future15.maki.bodyAdornment: A small secure simple lobe stud is allowed in Current baseline; no dangling/high-density jewelry and no tattoo.

explicitResolutions.future15.kai.bodyAdornment: NO_CURRENT_PIERCING. Twin similarity/difference comes from authored shared choices, wear, posture, storage and grooming, not random body modification.
